verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS search and Websets platform, but the evidence pack never documents exporting account data (Websets, enrichments, usage history) in open formats, nor an offboarding path. Retrieving search results or Websets items as JSON through the API, or receiving them by webhook, is a feature for delivering results, not a documented data-export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
